proof.text: Check linear maps on each Finsupp basis element with coefficient 1. The augmentation after its homotopy sends 1 to 1.
For degree zero, deleting the first entry of (s,t) yields (t) and deleting the second yields (s). Thus d h[t] = [t] - [s], while h epsilon[t] = [s].

For higher degrees, split the face sum into j=0 and j=k+1. The first face of Fin.cons s x is x; the (k+1)-st face is Fin.cons s (face k x), by Fin.cons_comp_succ_succAbove. Since (-1)^(k+1) = -(-1)^k, the remaining sum is minus h d x. Linearity and finite-sum cancellation give d h + h d = id.

theorem powerSetComplex_homotopy_identities :
    ∀ s : S,
      (powerSetComplexAugmentation A S).comp
          (powerSetComplexAugmentationHomotopy A S s) = LinearMap.id ∧
      (powerSetComplexDifferential A S 0).comp (powerSetComplexHomotopy A S s 0) +
          (powerSetComplexAugmentationHomotopy A S s).comp
            (powerSetComplexAugmentation A S) = LinearMap.id ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ,
        (powerSetComplexDifferential A S (p + 1)).comp
            (powerSetComplexHomotopy A S s (p + 1)) +
          (powerSetComplexHomotopy A S s p).comp
            (powerSetComplexDifferential A S p) = LinearMap.id
